notes.title: Community Update 3 - AFK Bananas
notes.content:
*SIGH* A lot of reviewers have been having a surprisingly difficult time understanding how to use the in-game currency to buy the banana bunches and that this particular clicker game requires actual clicking.

I have now removed the requirement for clicking to get the 2 hour afk bananas despite my preference.

notes.title: Community Update July 7th 2024 - Crafting!
notes.content:
-added crafting area (3* same color banana = 1* random color banana with chance of getting an effect + 50 points)
-added X in top right of the change banana screen so you don't have to change bananas
-changed default sort order of inventory items from none to color then type
-fixed small click area on fullscreen
-some other quality of life stuff I forget
